nom: PEACH & LILY Super Oasis Concentrated Serum

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry to very dry skin, including in dry climates, most frequently report that the serum relieves tightness, flaking, and dry patches and leaves skin plump and hydrated, though a couple say it sat on top of the skin without absorbing or produced no visible change.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers describing sensitive skin, including some with rosacea or eczema, mostly report no irritation and reduced redness or itching, but one sensitive-eczema-prone reviewer says the product occasionally flared her skin and did not always hydrate.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report good hydration without triggering their oily T-zone, with one noting her oily T-zone felt less oily after use.
segments.mature: Reviewers who mention mature skin (around 46-59 years old) generally report improved smoothness, plumpness and a more youthful look, though one 59-year-old reviewer with dry skin found it left a tacky, unabsorbed film.
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin reports the serum plumped her skin and helped with what she suspected was underlying dehydration.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using the serum alongside retinol or vitamin C report fine lines, crow's feet or overall skin looking younger and firmer; no dissent noted among those specifically citing aging.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers report significant, often fast, relief of dehydration with plumper, softer, dewy skin lasting through the day or overnight; a small minority (dry, sensitive-eczema, and one general reviewer) report no noticeable change or inconsistent hydration.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including some with rosacea or barrier-impaired skin, report reduced redness and calmer skin; one sensitive-eczema-prone reviewer reports the opposite, with occasional flare-ups.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describing a compromised or barrier-impaired state (post-retinol burn, allergic reaction, harsh actives) report fast healing, reduced pain, and restored comfort within hours to days.
concerns.spots: Not enough reviewer detail specific to spots/dark marks to characterize.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers who mention acne-prone or blemish-prone skin report no new breakouts and even faster healing of existing acne; one reviewer explicitly says the product broke her out and she discontinued use.
concerns.oiliness: A few reviewers with oily or combination skin report the serum hydrates without adding oiliness, and one notes her T-zone appeared less oily after use.

aspects.libelle: Tacky or sticky residue on skin
Long-lasting hydration through day or night
Pleasant scent and feel on application

extraits.texte: I am 59 and this is an HONEST Review. Reading through all the wonderful raves on this and also the spokes person for this line in Ulta mentioned how this would be good for my dry skin. I live in California where it is very dry so my skin need moisture! After applying this serum which felt nice but this serum sat on top of my skin, this did not absorb into my skin & felt very Tacky and Sticky for hours never absorb hours later! my skincare routine is,cleanse, exfoliate, tone, serum and moisturize.I take excellent care of my skin and it shows, But I would not recommend this product unless you like a film on your skin that leaves it Tacky! .

I don't notice a very big difference in using this versus other serums. I have very dry, sensitive, eczema prone skin with redness and I found this to flare up my skin once in a while and did not always help hydrate. I find that the glass skin serum works better for me on what the product is intended for. Personally won't repurchase but think the formula could work for other skin types

It was very hydrating and went into my routine nicely. However, I definitely think it's overpriced and it did break me out so I cannot continue to use it. I would only recommend giving it a try if you don't mind paying that much for a nice hydration product and you're not prone to breakouts.

extraits.titre: Best Product I've used for my rosacea
extraits.texte: I have very sensitive, combo skin. I have an oily T-zone and dry cheeks where my rosacea is at it's worse. I'm always red and itchy in my cheeks. I've tried other hyaluronic serums before and typically they actually irritate my rosacea. I bought this on a whim thinking it would be the same story but it's not. My redness is almost none existent and no more itching. I don't even have to wear a moisturizer over it. It's amazing

I am so impressed! My dry, red, barrier impaired skin was HEALED after 1 week of use. My skin is smooth, dewy, and most importantly… not red for the first time in my adult life. I truly feel like this is a miracle product. If these results persist, I will be using this product for life!

This is my favorite hydrating serum. It's very lightweight and yet super hydrating. I pair it with the Glass Skin Water-Gel Moisturizer and they work perfectly together. My skin is dehydrated and sensitive, prone to breakouts from silicones and oils. And these two products are a holy grail for my skin. Highly recommend to everyone!

This is my new holy grail from P&L! I have oily skin and didn't really know if my skin was dehydrated or not, but this plumps it up so much. It's full of antioxidants and is easy to fit into your routine.
